## Professional Work Experience

### 1. Evernorth Health Services (The Cigna Group) — Hyderabad, India
**Software Engineering Analyst** | July 2026 – Present
- Architected and deployed an enterprise GenAI recommendation service leveraging LLMs and LiteLLM to automate purge-or-hold decisions on compliance-flagged healthcare files.
- Engineered a robust backend recommendation pipeline using Java, Spring Boot, MongoDB, and REST APIs, filtering historical records by rule category and generating context-aware suggested actions, confidence scoring, and risk flags via event-driven workflows and cron batch workers.
- Conducted systematic LLM evaluation across 5 models on production workloads for consistency and token efficiency, configuring dynamic LiteLLM routing with automatic model fallbacks.
- Replaced static alerting with an interactive human-in-the-loop analyst dashboard, recording decisions with detailed audit logs.
- Modeled 24 file-processing stages as real-time Kafka status events persisted into MongoDB, powering live SLA tracking and integrating distributed tracing with trace and span IDs across microservices for distributed observability.

### 2. Evernorth Health Services — Hyderabad, India
**Software Engineering Intern** | July 2025 – June 2026
- Engineered an asynchronous cloud event pipeline on AWS (S3, Lambda, SQS, Kafka), migrating legacy processing flows to achieve low-latency asynchronous throughput.
- Automated detection and routing of unmatched medical-file transactions with scheduled Spring Boot batch services, employing idempotent processing and ShedLock distributed locking to guarantee zero duplicate alerts across multi-node instances.
- Engineered automated disaster recovery pipelines with Python REST utilities and S3-based snapshots for OpenSearch index recovery.
- Automated blue-green AWS Lambda deployments and artifact publishing pipelines using Terraform and CI/CD workflows.

## Featured Engineering Projects

### 1. Uber-Microservices (Distributed Ride-Matching Backend)
- GitHub: https://github.com/karansundariya/Uber-Microservices
- Stack: Java, Spring Boot, Apache Kafka, Redis Geospatial, MySQL, Docker
- Architecture: 3 Spring Boot microservices coordinating ride lifecycle, driver tracking, and matching. Utilizes Redis Geospatial indexing (GEOADD, GEORADIUS) for sub-millisecond proximity queries and Kafka pub/sub topics for asynchronous event decoupling across a 5-state ride lifecycle.

### 2. JobLex (Full-Stack MERN Campus Recruitment Platform)
- GitHub: https://github.com/karansundariya/JobLex

- Architecture: Mobile-first placement platform with role-based access control (Student, Recruiter, Admin), compound MongoDB indexing for multi-criteria search, and automated listing expiry lifecycle management.
